query: Which distribution-shift detection metrics and thresholds (KS, MMD, PDFF/T2 drift, SNR changes, image quality stats) reliably flag subtle biases introduced by replacement/inpainting?

response.query: Which distribution-shift detection metrics and thresholds (KS, MMD, PDFF/T2 drift, SNR changes, image quality stats) reliably flag subtle biases introduced by replacement/inpainting?
response.answer: KS, MMD, and PDFF/T2 drift metrics reliably flag subtle biases from replacement/inpainting. Thresholds vary by application but are typically set based on empirical validation.
